questions.prompt: Write the structure of lysine as it would be expected at its isoelectric point.
questions.explanation: Written-response source item; self-assessment only. The predominant net-neutral form near the pI has COO−, an uncharged alpha NH2, and a protonated terminal side-chain NH3+.

questions.prompt: Write the dissociation of acetic acid and the Henderson-Hasselbach Equation for it.
questions.explanation: Written-response source item; self-assessment only. CH3COOH ⇌ H+ + CH3COO−; pH = pKa + log10([CH3COO−]/[CH3COOH]).

questions.prompt: Write the structure of tryptophan as it would be expected at pH 7.
questions.explanation: Written-response source item; self-assessment only. At pH 7, the alpha amino group is NH3+ and the carboxyl group is COO−; the side chain is CH2–indole.
